items.title: Delta Air Lines (DAL) Stock May Be Undervalued After Falling Oil Prices
items.summary: Delta Air Lines has delivered a powerful share price run in recent years, which puts a bright spotlight on whether the current valuation lines up with the airline's earnings power.
